mensor_lp.og_description: Since 1969, Mensor has been designing and manufacturing precision pressure measuring and pressure calibration instruments and systems. From the very first quartz manometer for the aerospace industry to the modern CPC6050 Modular Pressure Calibrator today, Mensor - now a part of WIKA Calibration Line - specializes in providing quality pressure products and services to a wide variety of industries around the world.
